protocol.error_model: safe |K|<=160, dual-path solver spread, residual, and finite Weyl guard; Ky Fan spectral term multiplied by k; numerical only
protocol.matrix_entry: 1_{t!=u,p not_divides ut} p H^(2s)/(H^2+(u-t)^2)^s (1_{u==t mod p}-1/(p-1))
protocol.normalization: F_k divided by source count N
protocol.spectral_method: SciPy symmetric top-17 eigensolver plus NumPy full eigvalsh on forward and reverse shell accumulations
